purpose: A reduced persona schema selected from the MatrAIx source schema.

description_provenance.basis: Descriptions are derived from id, label, category, and values in the source schema.
description_provenance.scope: Project-level supplemental descriptions; not official MatrAIx definitions or causal claims.

tag_mapping_note: The current mapping selects persona context fields for enterprise, article, and product input tags. Thought, emotion, and attention-reason tags are state outputs, not persona mappings. Per-persona context ranking is not implemented.
principles: Source IDs and enum values are preserved.
Descriptions state the semantic scope of each field.
Product relevance is stored separately from field semantics.
Missing values remain missing; they are not converted to another enum.
The subset does not include brand/product state or event history.

activity_and_exposure.description: Attributes related to demographics, time, platforms, and attention capacity.

attention_and_cognition.description: Attributes related to personality, cognition, and information-processing tendencies.

purchase_and_preference.description: Attributes related to economic motivation, preferences, and shopping tendencies.

social_reaction_and_comment.description: Attributes related to communication, emotional expression, and disagreement handling.

cafe_domain.description: Attributes related to coffee, caffeine, food, and beverages.
